suites.name: guardrails
suites.title: Deterministic guardrails
suites.description: The no-LLM checks between the models and the reader: the verbatim-quote match, the number guard, the citation enum of the stage-B schema and the inline-marker cleaner. Genuine inputs (real verified quotes and facts) must pass; planted attacks (fabricated or paraphrased quotes, altered or invented numbers, citations to unseen sources, inline markers) must be caught.
suites.label_source: real verified quotes and numbers, with planted attacks

suites.name: fact_checker
suites.title: Stage-B fact-checker
suites.description: Stage B's model checker (the smart model since the experiments), which deletes claims their cited sources do not support. 30 claims over real excerpts, 16 with a planted error. Unsupported recall is the share of planted errors it removes; false removal is the share of true claims it deletes (lost content, since the check fails closed).
suites.label_source: claims written against real excerpts, with planted errors

suites.name: faithfulness
suites.title: Faithfulness of stored analyses
suites.description: Every factual item of 20 real stored stage-B analyses, rated by an independent LLM judge (the smart model, its own prompt) against the passages of its cited sources that best match it, taken from the text the stage-B writer was shown (about 2,000 characters per item), plus a deterministic check that every citation resolves to a source the analysis had. The judge is a model too.
suites.label_source: rated by a separate judge model; frozen export of stored analyses
